supported_external_measurements: lesion extent in pixels on original 512x512 grid
supported_interpretations: The evidence constructor reproduced all preserved prediction-derived lesion extents and uncertainty values without ground-truth access.
The predeclared source-derived p80 uncertainty gate transferred to MedSeg with very low external coverage.
The low coverage indicates that the source-calibration uncertainty distribution did not directly transfer to the external target domain.
Retained-set Dice is descriptive because each method and seed may retain a different subset of target cases.
No genuine four-view lesion-extent stability range could be evaluated because individual aligned view outputs were not preserved.
prohibited_interpretations: Do not claim the p80 gate provides 80 percent external-target coverage.
Do not tune the source uncertainty gate using MedSeg.
Do not rank methods using unmatched retained-set Dice.
Do not describe the four-view aggregate as a confidence interval.
Do not claim physical area, lesion volume, lung burden, laterality, or lobar localization.
